summary: This stylesheet styles a 'series box' that shows which post in a series the reader is currently viewing. Instead of using a background color (which would look washed out on the cream-colored page), it uses a left border as a visual accent, similar to a rail used elsewhere on the site. The list inside uses custom numbering, and the current post is highlighted in bold.

explanations.19: The border-left property creates a colored line on the left edge; var(--mk-rail) sets the width and var(--mk-primary) sets the color.
explanations.30: The 'composes' keyword pulls in styles from a global CSS class called mk-eyebrow, applying those styles to this element as well.
explanations.41: counter-reset starts a named counter called 'post-counter' at zero so it can count list items automatically.
explanations.46: counter-increment increases the post-counter by 1 for each list item, so we can display 1, 2, 3, etc.
explanations.58: The content property inserts the current value of the post-counter before each list item (this only works in ::before and ::after pseudo-elements).
explanations.64: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums makes all numbers the same width so lists align neatly instead of shifting when numbers like '9' change to '10'.
explanations.70: color: inherit makes both links and spans use whatever text color their parent has, instead of the browser's default link color.
